comment: Controls live gate decks (CONTROL_COVERAGE_PLAN.md): control/protection/metering elements in symmetric, asymmetric, and combination scenarios, live-compared by controls_cases_match_oracle with the full-model mandate plus element-specific state channels (probes / compare_variables / compare_eventlog / compare_ctrlqueue / check_meters_monitors). Cases with pending=true cover features the port does not implement yet (absorbed from the former gaps/ staging family, GAPS_PLAN.md section 3.1): the gate asserts the Rust engine errors loudly on them; the WP in each wp field flips pending=false when it ports the feature.

cases.note: WP-U1.3 / ledger L1 (InvControlDeltaV per-control 2-slot buffer). TWO InvControls on separate wye PVSystems (different monitored buses), both VOLTVAR, single snapshot. This deck is revision-insensitive: pv1/pv2 kvar are byte-identical on 0.14.5 and capi015 (probed -- the D1 buffer refactor is a proven numeric no-op in a snapshot), so it does NOT witness the D1 divergence live. The D1 time-series bug (shared FVpuSolutionIdx, only bites the 2nd+ control over a multi-step hysteresis run the capi015 oracle cannot re-nominalize -- STATUS/ledger L1) is pinned by the unit test d1_buffer_2slot_tracks_last_two_pu_voltages. What this deck gates is the generic multi-InvControl fleet build + independent per-control dispatch (pv1 kvar != pv2 kvar proves each control resolves its own DER / monitored voltage / curve Q); kept on capi015 to stay aligned with the WP-U1.3 target engine. Full-model per-element compare + event log, n_steps=1.

WP-U1.3 / row D4 (delta-DER LL monitored voltage). A DELTA-connected PVSystem under VOLTVAR: 0.15.x monitors line-to-line terminal voltages (InvControl.pas l.1647-1652), 0.14.5 used line-neutral. Feature-sensitive: LL vs LN flips the curve point and the var SIGN (probe scratch_probe_d4.py: capi015/r4133 Q=+520 kvar vs 0.14.5 -31 kvar). r4133==capi015 here. Gated capi015; per-step pv1 kvar (full-model) + event log exact.

WP-U2.1 handoff restore: the three-tier fuse-save race (backup relay -> midline recloser -> lateral fuse) re-armed on the version-consistent r4133 chain (Fuse U2.1 / Recloser U2.2 / Relay U2.3). The fuse melts phase 1 of L6 on the recloser's delayed cycle at Sec=0.9 while the recloser reclose restores the other phases and the backup relay never trips (probe-verified on oddie:r4133). Recloser/Relay per-phase state arrays + the per-phase event log (incl. the r4133 Relay 'Debug Sample' lines) compared vs oddie:r4133. EnergyMeter registers/zone + the mode-0 monitor channels are compared vs oddie:r4133 too (check_meters_monitors): the comparator now normalizes the Delphi monitor-CSV header artifact (leading-space + trailing-empty columns).

WP-U2.1 handoff restore: the classic three-tier fuse-save race (substation backup relay -> midline recloser -> lateral fuse) re-armed on the version-consistent r4133 chain (Fuse U2.1 / Recloser U2.2 / Relay U2.3). The recloser FAST shot clears at Sec=0.4, the fuse melts the faulted phase on the delayed cycle at Sec=0.5, the recloser recloses restoring service except the blown phase, and the backup relay never trips (probe-verified on oddie:r4133). Recloser/Relay per-phase state arrays + the per-phase event log compared vs oddie:r4133. EnergyMeter registers/zone + the mode-0 monitor channels are compared vs oddie:r4133 too (check_meters_monitors): the comparator now normalizes the Delphi monitor-CSV header artifact (leading-space + trailing-empty columns).

r4133 D2 removed-default WITNESS (intentionally curveless -> inert): a temporary 3ph fault on a recloser with no A/D curve assignment stays CLOSED on r4133, where 0.14.5's default A/D curves would have tripped. Kept curveless on purpose; the trip/reclose-to-CLOSED path is covered by recloser_ground and the ganged lockout by recloser_perm.

WP-U2.2 ganged lockout-to-OPEN: a 3ph permanent fault drives the ganged phase path (explicit phasefast=a phasedelayed=d, since r4133 D2 removed the default curves) -> FAST trip -> reclose -> SLOW trip -> reclose -> lockout -> ends [open,open,open]. Re-validates the do_open_ganged lockout branch against oddie:r4133 (restores the retired 0.14.5 golden's coverage).

WP-U2.1 (r4133 C3/D1): explicit fusecurve=tlink scaled by the new CurveMultiplier divisor (curvemultiplier=40 -> GetTCCTime(Cmag/40)) blows ONLY the SLG phase 2 at Sec=0.4 -> State=[closed,open,closed]. Feature-sensitive: curvemultiplier=1 melts all three at Sec=0.2 (probe-proven); RatedCurrent is the r4133 informational default 0, so dividing by it (the pre-r4133 divisor) would divide-by-zero and blow every phase -- pins CurveMultiplier as the divisor. r4133-only property. Full-model per-step + State/Normal probes + blow event log + ctrlqueue.

WP-U2.1 (r4133 breaking default D1): a legacy fuse (RatedCurrent only, no explicit curve) gets the r4133 default FuseCurve=none and NEVER blows even under a solid 3ph fault -> State stays [closed,closed,closed], empty blow event log + ctrlqueue (blew all three on 0.14.5). Pins the never-blows breaking default. r4133-only observable. Full-model per-step + State/Normal probes.

WP-U2.1 re-evaluation (2026-07-17): r4133 twin of the vendored InductionMachine/Master.DSS, which is UNSOLVABLE under r4133 by upstream design (INTENTIONAL breaking change, 11.0.0.1 release notes 'Protection Elements Enhancements': RatedCurrent demoted to informational nameplate, new CurveMultiplier default 1.0 is the TCC divisor, no legacy fallback -- Controls/fuse.pas Edit case 6 writes only RatedCurrent). Single functional edit: CurveMultiplier=65 on both fuses restores the original coordination -- Fuse.f2 (Tlink) sees ~54-56 A of motor load = 0.83x-0.86x of the 65 A curve base, below the 2.0x minimum-melt threshold, so it HOLDS (under the r4133 default divisor 1.0 the same current reads 54x-56x -> instant melt at Sec=0, islanding Transformer.Tg + IndMach012.Motor1 -> non-convergence; probe-proven on oddie:r4133, eventlog 'Fuse.f2 PHASE 1/2/3 BLOWN'). 1.7 validated on oddie:r4133 2026-07-17: converged 8/8 (iters 18,2,...,2), fingerprint sha256 0a90d76d bit-identical across two processes; feature-sensitive (divisor 65 vs default 1.0 flips converged/blown, the divide-by-RatedCurrent pre-r4133 path is pinned by sibling fuse_curvemult_blow). Full-model per-step + fuse State/Normal/curve/multiplier probes + eventlog + ctrlqueue. AD classified (DSS_AD_CLASSIFY probe, 2026-07-17): snapshot-mode and AD-eligible by mode, but the AD save/reload leg fails to re-open the deck's relative-path fixture wpwind2400.csv from the torn-circuit scratch dir (probe: 'ad-init: Error opening file: wpwind2400.csv') -> off:save-roundtrip-relpath, same class as ExpControl/Master.dss.

WP-U2.1 re-evaluation (2026-07-17): r4133 twin of the vendored InductionMachine/Run.dss (see indmach_snap note for the intentional-breaking-change verdict; CurveMultiplier=65 restores the RatedCurrent=65 coordination). Inline driver mirrors Run.dss: snapshot solve + 5001 dynamics steps at h=166.67us -- SLG fault at B3.1 applied t=0.3 s, Relay.mfrov/uv isolates the motor ~0.42 s, Recloser.rec1 trips FAST Sec=0.5115, temporary fault clears, both fuses HOLD (f2 fault-window multiples stay under the Tlink melt clock; r4088-era sequence reproduced identically on oddie:r4133). Monitors modes 0+3 (7 monitors, 5001 samples) compared; Run.dss's mode=5 Monitor.Mtime dropped (wall-clock channels, nondeterministic). Motor coast-down end-state f=57.2053 Hz slip=0.0466. 1.7 validated on oddie:r4133 2026-07-17: converged, fingerprint sha256 a73077ba (23.7 MB capture incl 30029-entry eventlog) bit-identical across two processes; feature-sensitive (without CurveMultiplier=65 the same circuit blows f2 at Sec=0 and does not converge -- the vendored original, probe-proven). n_steps=2 continues the dynamics one 166.67us step each (Set number=1). AD classified (2026-07-17): dynamics deck -> off:mode-outside-AD-scope (AD sweep is power-flow-only; precedent VCCS/DG_Prot_Fdr.dss); the DSS_AD_CLASSIFY probe additionally hits the same wpwind2400.csv save-roundtrip relpath failure as indmach_snap.

WP-U2.1 (r4133 breaking default D1): the default FuseCurve moved tlink->none, so this fuse (no explicit curve) NEVER blows on r4133 -- State stays [closed,...], the blow eventlog + ctrlqueue are empty (was 1 on 0.14.5). Pins the never-blows breaking default live; the CurveMultiplier-scaled blow path is the sibling fuse_curvemult_blow deck. RatedCurrent is now informational.

WP-U2.4 D6 (EPRI r4133 SwtControl.pas): FLIPPED capi015 -> r4133. The deprecated `Action` now forces the ACTUAL state immediately (like State), so the post `action=open` opens line.feed at parse time (before any step) instead of arming a delayed control-queue action. r4133-validated (§1.7 two-process determinant; the switch is open from step 0, line.feed |I|~7e-9, event log empty, control queue empty). Under capi015 (Rung-1) the same post armed a delayed action that fired at the 0.25 s delay (step 3) -- this deck's capi015 trajectory Closed x3 -> Open is exactly the r4088->r4133 D6 move. Render-form probes dropped: r4133 renders state/normal as `[open, open, open, ]` arrays (E3, WP-U2.5 scope) and does not wire prop-5 Delay (renders default 120), so the whole-model V/Y + empty eventlog/ctrlqueue pin the switch physics instead. Feature-sensitive: if Action regressed to setting only the normal state (r4088) the switch would stay closed and the model would not collapse.

r4133 D2 removed-default WITNESS (intentionally curveless -> inert) on the IEEE123-class midi net: a temporary 3ph fault on a curveless recloser stays CLOSED on r4133. Kept curveless on purpose (twin of recloser_temp); the ganged lockout is covered by midi_recloser_perm.

WP-U2.2 ganged lockout-to-OPEN on the IEEE123-class midi net: a 3ph permanent fault with explicit phasefast=a phasedelayed=d (r4133 D2 removed the defaults) -> FAST -> reclose -> SLOW -> reclose -> lockout -> ends [open,open,open]. Re-validates do_open_ganged against oddie:r4133 (twin of recloser_perm).

WP-U2.1 (r4133 breaking default D1): the default FuseCurve moved tlink->none, so this fuse (no explicit curve) NEVER blows on r4133 -- State stays [closed,...], the blow eventlog + ctrlqueue are empty (was 1 on 0.14.5). Pins the never-blows breaking default live; the CurveMultiplier-scaled blow path is the sibling fuse_curvemult_blow deck. RatedCurrent is now informational.

WP-U2.4 D6 (EPRI r4133 SwtControl.pas): FLIPPED capi015 -> r4133. The post `action=open` now forces the loop tie (line.tie) open immediately (D6: Action sets the actual state, like State), converting the meshed IEEE123-class midi network to radial at parse time -- a STRONG pin: the loads stay fed (min bus 0.889 pu) so the whole-model V/Y differs materially with the tie open. r4133-validated (§1.7 two-process determinant; line.tie |I|~7e-9, event log empty, control queue empty). Under capi015 (Rung-1) the same post armed a delayed action firing at step 3 -- the r4088->r4133 D6 move. Render-form probes dropped (r4133 renders state/normal as `[.., ..]` arrays, E3/WP-U2.5 scope); the whole-model compare pins the physics. Feature-sensitive: an Action regression to normal-only would leave the tie closed and the mesh intact.

cases.expect_solve_abort: Type is set to "Follow", but not "ControlSignal" was provided. Aborting solution.
cases.note: Malformed input: type=Follow CapControl with no ControlSignal. Pascal CapControl.pas Sample (l.1153-1158) sets DSS.SolutionAbort:=True; the pinned oracle raises #10362 at solve. Both engines abort; the Rust port sets solution_abort + surfaces the same message (WPG.7 audit follow-up).

ControlModel accepts only the ordinal (ControlModel=1); the enum name is rejected by the upstream text parser (probe-proven). WPG.9 ports the TPICtrl PI controller (Exponential ControlModel) in the VV/AVR/DRC/VV_DRC var-calc paths; live-compared here (kvar probe = the controller-driven var output + event log; the full-model compare covers the PV's P/Q each step). PVSystem exposes no `kW` property (probe-proven: `? PVSystem.pv.kW` = 'Property Unknown' on both engines), so the var trajectory is observed via `kvar`.

Storage grid-forming (ControlMode=GFM) forming an islanded section (sw1 opened) in daily mode. Feature-sensitive: WITHOUT ControlMode=GFM the islanded storage cannot form voltage and islbus is dead (0 pu, 0 kW) vs the GFM island at ~0.998 pu / ~400 kW. Two-process oracle capture bit-identical (determinism proven). Flipped oracle:capi015 by the GFM WP: the discharging GFM storage reaches CalcGFMYprim, so the B5 Isc1 change (drop *1000, dss_capi de6a5a42 = SVN r3865; DIVERGENCES.md #b5) moves the assembled system Y at the StoBus mutuals (0.14.5 vs capi015 rel 1.209e-1). The op-point is Isc1-invariant, so the ~0.998 pu / ~400 kW feature-sensitivity and the monitor channels are unchanged; only the Norton YPrim moved.

InvControl mode=GFM amps limiter over a grid-forming Storage (islanded like gfm_micro). AmpLimit=400 makes CheckAmpsLimit bite (dynVars.IComp>0 -> DoGFM_Mode shrinks BaseV): Storage throttled to ~-158 kW vs ~-400 kW without the limit (feature-sensitive, ~2.5x per step). Two-process oracle capture bit-identical (determinism proven). Flipped oracle:capi015 by the GFM WP: the discharging GFM storage reaches CalcGFMYprim, so B5 (Isc1 drop *1000, de6a5a42/SVN r3865; DIVERGENCES.md #b5) moves the StoBus mutual Y (rel 1.209e-1); op-point Isc1-invariant, so the throttled ~-158 kW feature-sensitivity is unchanged.

Storage grid-forming (ControlMode=GFM) BLACK-STARTING an islanded section (sw1 opened) in DYNAMICS mode (one solve = 60x 1ms steps; mode-0 + mode-3 monitors). Exercises the ported dynamics-mode GFM: IntegrateStates VDelta droop -> ISPDelta ramp + FixPhaseAngle, DoDynamicMode BaseV=BasekV*1000*(it[0]/iMaxPPhase) internal-source injection, CheckIfDelivering. Re-probed pinned oracle dss-python 0.15.7 (WPG.17): (1) compiles+solves+converges; (2) two-process ByteStream bit-identical (mvi sha 1edc4824..., msv sha d049f4a6...); (3) feature-sensitive -- WITH ControlMode=GFM+SafeVoltage=0 the island energises to islbus ~0.977 pu with the Storage delivering ~-400.7 kW / ~-80.9 kvar (State=DISCHARGING, %stored ~99.9999), vs WITHOUT ControlMode=GFM the islanded inverter is NON-CONVERGENT (NaN node voltages, 0 kW). SafeVoltage=0 is mandatory (default 100 MinVS blocks the black start from 0 V). Flipped oracle:capi015 by the GFM WP: the discharging GFM storage reaches CalcGFMYprim, so B5 (Isc1 drop *1000, de6a5a42/SVN r3865; DIVERGENCES.md #b5) moves the StoBus mutual Y (rel 1.209e-1); the dynamics op-point (islbus ~0.977 pu, ~-400.7 kW) is Isc1-invariant and the monitor channels are unchanged.

PVSystem twin of gfm_dynamics.dss (GFM audit settlement: the PV GFM dynamics path previously had only a last-sample unit pin). Islanded PV in ControlMode=GFM black-starts the section in dynamics mode (60x 1ms; mode-0 + mode-3 monitors); exercises PVsystem.pas InitStateVars GFM it:=0 seed, IntegrateStates GFM droop with the OVERWRITTEN iMaxPPhase (unlike Storage's local IMaxPhase), DoDynamicMode GFM injection. Validated pinned oracle dss-python 0.15.7 (2026-07-09): (1) compiles+solves+converges; (2) two-process fingerprint (AllBusVmag + both monitor ByteStreams) bit-identical 9981f5f49a610a61; (3) feature-sensitive -- WITHOUT ControlMode=GFM the islanded dynamics solve is NON-CONVERGENT. SafeVoltage=0 mandatory. Flipped oracle:capi015 by the GFM WP: the generating GFM PVSystem reaches CalcGFMYprim, so B5 (Isc1 drop *1000, de6a5a42/SVN r3865; DIVERGENCES.md #b5) moves the PVBus mutual Y (rel 1.209e-1). WP-U1.2 D7 (iMaxPPhase base) is a numeric no-op here (kVA=Pmpp=800), so capi015 == 0.14.5 for the op-point; only the Norton YPrim moved.
Feature-sensitive probe-proven: with Set SeasonRating=no the event log diverges from hour 12 (the 500 kW season target never engages). Option spelling is 'Set SeasonRating', not 'SeasonalRating'.
RegControl drives the AutoTrans COMMON (wye) winding via the Pascal Transf_Or_AutoTrans proxy. Oracle 2026-07-05: 10 tap-change events over the 8 hours, final tapnum=5.
Snapshot Solve then the daily run in one session - cross-mode state-leak coverage.
Snapshot Solve then the RegControl daily run in one session (12 tap events, final tapnum=5 on the oracle) - cross-mode state-leak coverage.
Control-active at midi scale on the oracle: 10 tap events, final tapnum=11.

LDC forward path (RegControl.pas Sample l.1040-1048): R+jX line-drop comp shifts the effective control voltage with load current. Feature-sensitive: neutralizing r=0 x=0 changes the tap event log (two-process oracle capture bit-identical; probe-proven).

Reversible + reverse setpoints: a downstream generator ramp drives reverse power through the LTC past revThreshold, flipping InReverseMode so it regulates to revVreg/revBand. Feature-sensitive: reversible=no keeps it forward-only (different taps/event log; probe-proven).

WP-U1.6 C5 (r4086, 8a898cba): RegControl idle-zone no-load suppression. idle=yes on a reversible regulator drops the pending tap when through-power lands in the default -100/+100 kW dead-band (which spans the whole axis, upstream >=/<= OR), so it never taps: a NON-idle reg taps up to 1.09375 (tapnum 15, |V|~0.939 pu) but idle=yes holds tap 1.0 (tapnum 0, |V|~0.864 pu) -- ~0.075 pu gap, far above every live floor. idle is 0.15.x-only (0.14.5 rejects it), so gated capi015 not 0.14.5 (section 1.2). Validated per section 1.7 (two-process determinism on capi015). Probed idle=yes vs idle=no 2026-07-16.

Remote regulated bus (UsingRegulatedBus): the regulator holds a bus one line-section downstream via RemotePTRatio. Feature-sensitive: watching the local winding (bus=mv) lands a different tap trajectory by the daily line drop (probe-proven).

Inverse-time tap delay + Vlimit clamp (RegControl.pas ComputeTimeDelay l.1294 + VLimit l.1086-1096). DUTY mode 2s steps: an overvoltage source (pu=1.045) drives a multi-tap buck so inverse-time places taps on different sub-steps and Vlimit=119 (below the vreg=120/band=4 window) bucks the endpoint lower. Feature-sensitive on BOTH knobs (probe-proven, two-process bit-identical): inversetime=no shifts the first tap Sec=10->18, vlimit=0 settles at tap 0.975 vs 0.95625.

PFCONTROL: offsetting=-0.99 exercises the leading PF1to2 fold; a low-PF load ramp pulls the bank ON and the added kvar sheds it toward the leading OFF target. Feature-sensitive (probe-proven, two-process bit-identical): type=pf vs type=kvar differ (PFCONTROL branch taken) and offsetting=-0.99 vs +0.90 gives a different step trajectory. pctMinkvar=25 does NOT bite here (pctminkvar=0 is bit-identical) and onsetting is inert (no re-ON after shedding) -- both are configured, not claimed as boundaries.

TIMECONTROL: cc1 ON<OFF (8-20h), cc2 OFF<ON so its window WRAPS past midnight (ON 21-06h; the next-day branch). cnight is ON at hours 0-5 and 21-23. Feature-sensitive: shifting cc2 offsetting moves the switch (probe-proven).

Voltage override ahead of the kvar logic: a kvar-latched bank is shed by the High-Voltage Override (126.4 V > Vmax=126) during a light-load overvoltage window. Feature-sensitive: voltoverride=no leaves it ON (probe-proven). VoverrideBus reverts at parse upstream (documented no-op), so it senses the monitored terminal.

DRC standalone: a 4h DRC window lags the ramping bus V so deltaV drives the ArGraHiV droop above DbVMax. Feature-sensitive: DbVMax=1.5 collapses the response (two-process bit-identical; probe-proven).
CombiMode VV_DRC (untested combi branch): VV-curve Q + DRC-droop Q summed (CalcVVDRC_vars). Feature-sensitive: DbVMax=1.5 removes the DRC term (probe-proven).
WATTPF: wattpf_curve maps P(pu) -> target PF, Q derived from P and PF. Feature-sensitive: unity-PF curve removes the response (probe-proven).
WATTVAR: wattvar_curve maps P(pu) -> target Q(pu) with the kVA-circle quadratic. Feature-sensitive: zero-var curve removes the response (probe-proven).

AVR with the DEFAULT (linear) ControlModel - the 3-stage DQDV regulator toward Vsetpoint (distinct from invcontrol_expmodel's Exponential model). Feature-sensitive: Vsetpoint=1.06 collapses the response (probe-proven).

Explicit monBus=(r.1.2.3) monVoltageCalc=MAX: the VV control samples a remote bus (GetMonVoltage FUsingMonBuses branch), not its own terminal. Feature-sensitive: monBus=b changes the sampled V and the kvar trajectory (probe-proven).

Midi: mixed 3ph+1ph DER fleet under one DRC control so the per-member FNphases recalc runs across differing phase counts in the multi-control round (the last-member FNphases-bug trait). Feature-sensitive: DbVMax=1.5 collapses the fleet response (probe-proven).
Follow discharge (MODE_FOLLOW): TimeDischargeTrigger latches kWTarget=max(kWThreshold,load) then holds; RELEASE_INHIBIT differs. Feature-sensitive: modedis=peakshave changes dispatch (probe-proven).

Support discharge (MODE_SUPPORT): Pdiff=Pmon+kWTarget, opposite sign to PeakShave; a generator backfeed reverses the monitored power. Feature-sensitive: modedis=peakshave dispatches differently (probe-proven).

I-PeakShave discharge (CURRENT_PEAKSHAVE): target in AMPS (kWTarget=0.24=240A), distinct amps->kW conversion via the terminal voltage. Feature-sensitive: modedis=peakshave (kW target) dispatches on a different quantity (probe-proven).

Loadshape dispatch (DoLoadShapeMode): the controller's own Daily shape commands charge(mult<0)/idle(0)/discharge(mult>0) directly - both loadshape branches at once. Feature-sensitive: zeroing the dispatch shape freezes the fleet (probe-proven).

Charge PeakShaveLow (DoPeakShaveModeLow): charges the fleet when the monitored power falls below kWTargetLow (valley fill), untouched by the Time-charge decks. Feature-sensitive: modecharge=time charges on a clock trigger instead (probe-proven).
VOLTAGE (27 undervoltage): a bolted 3ph fault at the monitored bus collapses V below the UnderVolt TCC -> UV trip + lockout. Feature-sensitive: a deep UV pickup keeps it in-band (probe-proven).

REVERSEPOWER (32): a downstream generator ramp backfeeds reverse power past PhaseInst -> one-shot lockout (RevPowerLogic). Feature-sensitive: PhaseInst above the backfeed keeps it closed (probe-proven).

GENERIC: watches the Storage 'kWh' state variable (a StorageController discharges it) and trips the feeder open when energy drops below undertrip. Feature-sensitive: undertrip below end-of-run kWh stops the trip (probe-proven).

DISTANCE (21 mho): apparent-impedance reach to a bolted 3ph fault inside Mphase -> trip + lockout (Kersting ex.4.1 impedances). Feature-sensitive: Mphase below the fault distance stops the trip (probe-proven).

TD21 (time-distance): the memory ring-buffer distance element primes over duty sub-steps before the in-reach fault, then trips + locks out. Feature-sensitive: Mphase below the fault distance stops the trip (probe-proven).

DOC (directional overcurrent): DOC_P1Blocking=TRUE (default) trips only on net reverse power; a downstream generator export drives reverse current into the trip region past DOC_TripSettingLow. Feature-sensitive: raising the pickup stops the trip (probe-proven).

Ground-curve path: groundfast/grounddelayed ASSIGNED (else GroundCurve=NIL skips the path, Recloser.pas l.355/578) and phasetrip=3000 set above the SLG faulted-phase current (~2585A) so only the ground curve trips on the residual (~2558A) through the low groundtrip=30 pickup (eventlog GROUND TARGET, Sec=0.4). Temporary fault self-clears, recloses. Feature-sensitive (probe-proven): groundtrip=3000 stops the trip and dropping groundfast/grounddelayed stops it, while phasetrip=30000 is bit-identical (phase path inert).

WP-U2.2 single-phase trip/lockout (SinglePhTrip=yes): an SLG fault on phase 1 opens ONLY phase 1 (State [open,closed,closed]) with per-phase event-log wording ('Phase 1 opened on Ph Fast (1ph trip)'). Feature-sensitive on r4133: SinglePhTrip=no trips all three; PhFastPickup above the SLG current stops the trip (probe-proven).

WP-U2.2 fast/slow pickup split: PhFastPickup=50 lets the fast op trip a permanent 3ph fault, PhSlowPickup=6000 (above the current) keeps the slow op from re-tripping -> reclose then stays CLOSED. Feature-sensitive on r4133: PhSlowPickup=50 instead locks out open (probe-proven).

WP-U2.1 (r4133 breaking default D1): default FuseCurve tlink->none, so this 3ph deck (no explicit curve) NEVER blows on r4133 -- State stays [closed,closed,closed], blow eventlog empty (was PHASE n BLOWN on 0.14.5). Pins the never-blows breaking default live.
Lock=yes makes the control IGNORE the post action=open, so the switch stays closed. Feature-sensitive: with lock=no the same action opens it after the delay (probe-proven).

kvarLimit clamp + unequal weights [4,2,1] over 3 gens: the load swing drives the reactive share past kvarLimit=400 so the clamp bites. Feature-sensitive: kvarlimit=99999 removes the clamp and the kvar split differs (probe-proven).

Option flags LineLosses=no/XfmrLosses=no/VbaseLosses=no over a line+transformer zone -> the loss/overload registers accumulate differently. Feature-sensitive: default all-on options record different registers (two-process bit-identical; register compare).

High save-record branches (ported): mode 6 (cap switching) on a switched cap, mode 9 (losses) on a transformer, mode 11 (all-terminal V&I) on a line. The mode selects the byte-stream channel set; the per-step channel arrays are compared. Modes 8/10/12 have a deferred stub sample body in the port and are not exercised.
Flag-bit save branches on an unbalanced feeder: mode 16 (+sequence V012/I012), mode 32 (+magnitude), mode 48 (both). Each flag changes the channel layout; the per-step channel arrays are compared.

ExpControl (IEEE-1547 adaptive volt-var, separate element): the adaptive Vreg tracks with VregTau and clamps to [VregMin,VregMax], DeltaQ_factor damping. A wide daily irradiance ramp moves Vreg and hits the clamps. Feature-sensitive: enabled=no holds fixed Q (probe-proven).

UPFC mode 1 (series voltage regulator) + UPFCControl wrapper: injects a series Vpq through Xs to drive the output to refkV (UPFC.pas GetOutputCurr ModeUPFC=1). Modes 2/3 are NOT covered here: mode-2 series path is a CurrOut:=0 stub in dss_capi 0.14.5 (identical to off) and its shunt reactive-comp path needs element= and does not converge in this topology; mode 3 collapses onto mode 1 here (see STATUS). Feature-sensitive (probe-proven): mode=0 removes the injection AND refkV=0.250/0.230 each shift the regulated output (two-process bit-identical).

UPFC mode 4 (DoubleReference voltage) + UPFCControl wrapper: two-band reference [refkV2,refkV]; the loaded input sags below the band and the UPFC engages via sf2. Feature-sensitive: mode=0 OR widening the band (input stays inside -> disengaged) each differ (probe-proven).

UPFC mode 2 (StatCOM / shunt reactive compensation): the series path is OFF (GetOutputCurr mode 2 = CurrOut:=0, so Sr0 stays 0) and the device injects a shunt reactive current at Bus1 sized from CalcUPFCPowers(2) and the target pf (QIdeal, clamped to kvarLimit). CheckStatus mode 2 = checkPF() only, so element= is mandatory; here it monitors the input service transformer and drives its PF toward pf=0.95 (QIdeal ~3.1 kvar, unclamped; 16 iters). All 14 UPFC state variables compared + full model. Feature-sensitive (two-process bit-identical, probe-proven): mode=0 zeros QIdeal, pf=0.90 flips QIdeal sign (-1140 var).

UPFC mode 3 (Dual: series voltage regulation to refkV + shunt PF correction). GetOutputCurr mode 3 runs the mode-1 series Vpq to drive Vbout to refkV and sets SyncFlag inside tol1; GetInputCurr mode 3 then, while synced, absorbs reactive power (QIdeal clamped to kvarLimit) on top of the loss-balancing current. CheckStatus mode 3 = voltage-error OR checkPF(), so element= is required (monitors the input service transformer; without it mode 3 collapses onto mode 1). pf=0.99/kvarLimit=20/tol1=0.005 keeps the target reachable -> Vbout ~242 V AND QIdeal ~7570 var (25 iters). All 14 UPFC state variables + full model. Feature-sensitive (two-process bit-identical): mode=1 keeps the SAME series V (Sr0 identical) but QIdeal=0 -> isolates the dual shunt branch; mode=0 removes both.

UPFC mode 5 (Double Reference, Dual: mode-4 two-band reference + mode-3 shunt PF correction). While |Vbin| is inside [refkV2, refkV] the device is off (SF2=False); the loaded interface sags |Vbin| below refkV2*1000, so the lower band engages (VRefD=refkV2), the series path regulates Vbout to ~238 V AND the shunt branch drives the monitored PF toward pf=0.99 (QIdeal ~7.8 kvar). element= required for the checkPF branch. tol1=0.005 settles both deadbands (25 iters). All 14 UPFC state variables + full model. Feature-sensitive (two-process bit-identical): mode=4 keeps the SAME double-ref series V (Sr0 identical) but QIdeal=0 -> isolates the dual shunt branch; widening the band disengages the device (Sr0=0); mode=0 removes both.

UPFC mode 3 (Dual) DAILY multi-step: gates the Sr0/Sr1 shift-register cross-step persistence (UPFC.pas ll.81-82, never zeroed between solves; Rust upfc/mod.rs recalc mirrors via Vec::resize) that the snapshot upfc_dual deck cannot reach. A 4-point daily loadshape (0.7/1.0/1.25/0.9) ramps the load each hour so the UPFC re-regulates from the Sr0/Sr1 carried over from the prior step. All 4 steps converge (22/16/26/24 iters); QIdeal walks per step (5340/7727/9465/6885 var). All 14 UPFC state variables + full model compared PER STEP.
